findings.title: Staff quotes/invoices view_assigned without assignment filter
findings.attack_path: Authenticated staff with quotes.view_assigned or invoices.view_assigned can list/read all rows via service-role repository paths; projects correctly filter by project_manager_id.
findings.impact: Horizontal privilege escalation among staff; customer financial data overexposure.
findings.recommended_fix: Enforce assignment/org filters matching permission semantics; add regression tests.

findings.title: Admin documents list not org-scoped for view_organization
findings.attack_path: Permission gate allows access then service-role query returns all documents without organization filter.
findings.impact: Cross-organization document metadata/content exposure among staff roles.
findings.recommended_fix: Filter by organization (and project membership) consistent with permission name.

findings.title: Invoice SECURITY DEFINER RPCs executable by any authenticated staff
findings.attack_path: GRANT EXECUTE TO authenticated; functions only check is_staff_admin() (any admin_roles row), bypassing app permission matrix (invoices.issue etc.).
findings.impact: Vertical privilege escalation within staff; financial state changes without intended RBAC.
findings.recommended_fix: Revoke authenticated execute; call via service role after requirePermission, or encode fine-grained checks in RPC.

findings.title: Mollie webhook token optional (fail-open when unset)
findings.attack_path: If MOLLIE_WEBHOOK_TOKEN unset, verifyMollieWebhookToken returns valid; attacker with paymentId can trigger processing path.
findings.impact: Unauthenticated webhook invocation / email side effects / API load. Cannot forge paid without Mollie, but unsafe for production enablement.
findings.recommended_fix: Fail-closed require token in production; reject when unset.

findings.title: Apply docs still cite pre-freeze HEAD b01d518 and mixed freeze status
findings.impact: Operator confusion; wrong apply HEAD if followed literally.
findings.recommended_fix: Update docs to freeze HEAD 1544d44 and resolve NOT EXECUTED vs PASS wording.

findings.title: Manifest SHA256 changed from c4cc9d… to 948073dd…; gitignored evidence stale
findings.impact: Authorization messages using old hash would be invalid.
findings.recommended_fix: Use only current hash 948073dd…; archive old evidence clearly.

findings.title: FINAL plan backup path 20260721-210514 vs proven 20260721-222511
findings.impact: Wrong backup selected for apply.
findings.recommended_fix: Align FINAL plan to 222511.

findings.title: Full vitest suite: 1 timeout failure in commercial-price.test.ts
findings.impact: CI flake / incomplete proof of commercial pricing UI labels.
findings.recommended_fix: Stabilize/async timeout; re-run to confirm flake vs real fail.

findings.title: Playwright e2e blocked by occupied localhost:3000
findings.impact: End-to-end site flows UNPROVEN this audit.
findings.recommended_fix: Free port or reuseExistingServer; re-run e2e.

findings.title: Some db:verify-* scripts use .env remote while labeling local
findings.impact: False FAIL against production (RPCs not applied yet) or REFUSE; confuses local gate evidence.
findings.recommended_fix: Force docker-local target like other verifiers; never hit remote unless explicit.

findings.title: Deployment provenance: origin/main at b01d518; freeze HEAD local-only ahead +2
findings.impact: Live site not proven to match freeze baseline.
findings.recommended_fix: Deploy/push only after fixes + explicit authorization; verify Vercel deployment SHA.

findings.title: Sitemap incomplete vs marketing solutions routes
findings.impact: SEO discoverability gaps.
findings.recommended_fix: Include all public indexable solutions URLs.

findings.title: error.tsx only under marketing segment
findings.impact: Poor error UX for admin/portal/shop on failures.
findings.recommended_fix: Add segment error boundaries.

findings.title: Auth callback builds redirects from request.url origin
findings.impact: Host-header open redirect risk if mis-proxied (UNPROVEN on Vercel).
findings.recommended_fix: Use canonical resolveAppUrl().

findings.title: npm audit: moderate postcss via next (2 findings)
findings.impact: Theoretical CSS stringify XSS in toolchain; exploitability in this app low/unproven. audit fix --force would downgrade Next — do not apply.
findings.recommended_fix: Track Next patch; never npm audit fix --force.

findings.title: Accessibility, Lighthouse performance, mobile matrix largely UNPROVEN this run
findings.impact: Cannot claim WCAG AA or Core Web Vitals PASS.
findings.recommended_fix: Dedicated a11y/perf audit pass with tooling evidence.

findings.title: No web app manifest
findings.impact: PWA/install metadata missing.
findings.recommended_fix: Add manifest if product requires.

findings.title: CSP allows 'unsafe-inline' scripts/styles
findings.impact: Weaker XSS defense-in-depth.
findings.recommended_fix: Nonce/hash CSP when feasible.

findings.title: Duplicate solution URL variants (livechat/live-chat, reviewflows/review-flows)
findings.impact: Duplicate content / canonical complexity.
findings.recommended_fix: Canonicalize with redirects.

findings.title: Portal deliverables and opleveringen parallel routes
findings.impact: UX duplication risk.
findings.recommended_fix: Consolidate or redirect.

findings.title: Next.js middleware → proxy deprecation warning on build
findings.impact: Future Next upgrade friction.
findings.recommended_fix: Migrate when Next docs require.

findings.title: robots.txt does not disallow /portal/
findings.impact: Mitigated by noindex on auth/portal pages; defense-in-depth gap.
findings.recommended_fix: Disallow /portal/ and auth paths in robots.

findings.title: Locale cookie lacks Secure flag
findings.impact: Low; locale preference only.
findings.recommended_fix: Set Secure in production.
